pages.text: The Regulator Upgrade allows machines to control the flow of items, ensuring that specific amounts are maintained in the network.
Features:$(li)Controls item flow$(li)Maintains specific item amounts$(li)Works in machines like Exporters$(li)Increases power consumption
To use the Regulator Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a compatible machine$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Configure the desired item amounts$(li)Machine will maintain specified quantities
